verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਾਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਨ ਅਪੜਿ ਸਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh dhiaan samaadh lai gurmukh roop na apaR sakai|

en.bdb: Millions of meditational postures and concentrations cannot equal the form of the gurmukh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਡਾਰੀ ਥਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh giaan vakhaan kar sabadh surat uddaaree thakai|

en.bdb: Millions got tired with learning and elaborations and with flights of consciousness to reach the divine Word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਲਖ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਨਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਦਰਿ ਧਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: budh bal bachan bibek lakh ddeh ddeh pavan piram dhar dhakai|

en.bdb: Millions of people using their intellect and powers talk of discerning wisdom but they fall and stagger, and, at the door of the Lord they get jolts and blows.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਲਖ ਸਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਹਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: jog bhog bairaag lakh seh na sakeh gun vaas mahakai|

en.bdb: Millions of yogis, pleasure seekers and recluses cannot bear the passions and fragrance of the three qualities of nature (sattv, rajas and tamas).

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਅਚਰਜ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੋਇ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh acharaj acharaj hoi abigat gat abigat vich akai|

en.bdb: Millions of wonderstruck people have got tired of the unmanifest nature of the unmanifest Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਲਖ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਮਿ ਸਹਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: visamaadhee visamaadh lakh akath kathaa vich saham sahakai|

en.bdb: Millions are awe-struck, with the ineffable story of that wondrous Lord.
They all are equal to the delight of one moment of the life of a Sikh of the Guru.
